integral_floats: a2a-rs encodes A2A metadata through protobuf Struct, so integers in metadata go on the wire as floats (5.0; Go: 5); gadk-a2a decodes metadata through Go's JSON text, so integral floats still fill integer fields

deltas.divergence: a2a-rs's client sends reqwest's Accept: */* on non-streaming JSON-RPC and REST calls and on the agent-card fetch, and Accept: text/event-stream alone on streaming calls (a2a-go v2.7.0: no Accept for non-streaming JSON-RPC, application/a2a+json, application/json for non-streaming REST, text/event-stream, application/json for streaming)
